clueVerdicts.explanation: The clue's 1962 World's Fair completion, 605-foot height, 520-foot observation deck, and 41-second elevator ride uniquely identify the Space Needle.
The 128-story, 632-meter height, floors 118 and 119 observation decks, and 20.5-meter-per-second elevator record identify Shanghai Tower.
The world's-largest-frame description, dimensions, Zabeel Park setting, and contrasting old and new Dubai views identify Dubai Frame.
The indoor 360-degree deck on the 100th floor, 60-second lift journey from the second floor, and April 2011 opening identify Sky100.
The 102-story Art Deco design, 1930–31 construction, 1,250-foot roof height, and 86th- and 102nd-floor observatories identify the Empire State Building Observatory.
